source.title: Concentrations and size distribution of TiO2 and Ag engineered particles in five wastewater treatment plants in the United States.
source.access: Europe PMC primary bibliographic record and abstract; full text not inspected

interpretation: The 2% tracked-effluent factor produces 0.0022–0.0066 ug/L, below the published 0.01–0.04 ug/L aggregate total-Ag range. This is a warning about applicability and measurand alignment, not proof of a same-measurand predictive error. The model also transfers 8% outside the tracked parent-material boundary; its aqueous destination is unspecified. Total-Ag comparison requires this transformed fraction to be resolved. No default fitting was performed.
limitations: Aggregate ranges are not paired plant observations.
Sampling year, plant flows, influent composition and analytical fractions are not available in the inspected abstract.
Total Ag proxy may not equal tracked particle-equivalent Ag.
US wastewater plants do not validate Korean ambient water, air, soil or sediment PEC.
No paired RMSE, R2 or holdout validation is claimed.
